mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a specific threshold.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the correlation between UNRATE decline and positive returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, it indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers borrowing costs and stimulates equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate strong aggregate demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p<0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion, or the return in such periods is not significantly higher than the overall average (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressures that typically lead to central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a specific threshold.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL rise and negative returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) exceed 600,000 units, it signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a labor market recovery that precedes corporate hiring and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% and UNRATE is declining, or the return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment growth (PAYEMS) signal a robust manufacturing and labor market expansion that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in INDPRO and PAYEMS does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p<0.05.
